a11y.title: Reading and display
a11y.voiceModeHelp: When this is on, pointing at a control reads it aloud.

voice.loginEmail: Work email. Type the email address you use for this nursery.
voice.loginPassword: Password. Type your secret word. You can show or hide the letters.
voice.signIn: Sign in. Press this to enter the nursery system.
voice.logout: Logout. Press this to leave the system.
voice.menu: Menu. Press this to open the list of sections.
voice.motherPlants: Mother plants. There are {{count}} mother trees in the registry.
voice.activeBatches: Active batches. {{count}} batches are still growing.
voice.readySkus: Ready plants. {{count}} kinds are in stock, {{units}} plants altogether.
voice.lowStock: Low stock. {{count}} plants need to be reordered.
voice.totalSales: Total sales. The money collected is shown here.
voice.vermiYield: Vermicompost. The harvested soil weight is shown in kilograms.
voice.profit: Potential profit. This is the money you may earn from current stock.
voice.addMother: Add mother plant. Press this to register a new mother tree.
voice.tagNumber: The system creates a unique tag when you save, so this mother plant can be identified exactly.
voice.variety: Variety. This list follows the plant you chose. Search it. If the name is not there, choose Other and type it inside the list. It is saved for every nursery.
voice.country: Source country. Choose where this plant came from.
voice.category: Category. Choose the kind of plant, such as fruit, flower, foliage, medicinal, or exotic.
voice.plantName: Plant name. Search the list, such as Guava or Mango. Other lets you add a name every nursery can use.
voice.vendor: Source vendor. Optional. Type the nursery or supplier this plant was bought from.
voice.methods: Propagation method. Choose every way this mother plant is used, such as grafting or air layering.
voice.health: Health. Choose how the tree is growing right now.
voice.capacity: Season capacity. Optional. Type how many scions or cuttings you expect in one season.
voice.listPrice: Ready plant price. Optional. What one baby plant will sell for when it is ready.
voice.video: Video. Optional. One clip up to 500 MB, shown on the public plant page.
voice.plantingDate: Planting date. Choose the day this tree was planted.
voice.plot: Plot location. Type where the tree stands in the field. Example: Plot A, Line 4.
voice.saveMother: Save. Press this to keep the mother plant and make its tag.
voice.description: Description. Optional words about this plant, such as taste, colour, or habit.
voice.plantPhotos: Mother plant photos. Optional pictures of the tree. Plant and fruit photos together can be 10 at most.
voice.fruitPhotos: Fruit photos. Optional pictures of the fruit. Plant and fruit photos together can be 10 at most.
voice.logScion: Log scion. Opens Propagation Hub so a batch can be started from this mother plant.
voice.adjustStock: Adjust stock. Record plants lost, found, or purchased.
voice.newBatch: New batch. Press this to start a new group of young plants.
voice.motherSelect: Mother plant. Choose the tree these young plants come from.
voice.method: Method. Choose how the young plants are made.
voice.quantity: Quantity. Type how many young plants are in this batch.
voice.startBatch: Start batch. Press this to begin the new group.
voice.markReady: Mark ready. Press this when the plants can be sold.
voice.createStock: Create stock. Press this to put the plants into inventory and make a QR code.
voice.searchInventory: Search. Type a plant name or SKU, then press search.
voice.qr: QR label. Press this to see the printed tag for this plant.
voice.printLabel: Print label. Press this to print the plant tag.
voice.scan: Scan box. Scan the plant tag, or type the SKU, then press add.
voice.addSku: Add. Press this to put the scanned plant into the cart.
voice.channel: Sales channel. Choose retail counter, wholesale, or an online shop.
voice.customer: Customer name. Type who is buying.
voice.phone: Phone. Type the customer phone number if you have it.
voice.payment: Payment. Choose cash, UPI, or bank transfer.
voice.checkout: Complete sale. Press this to take payment and reduce stock.
voice.registerBed: Register bed. Press this to add a new vermicompost bed.
voice.bedCode: Bed code. Type the name of this compost bed.
voice.cowDung: Cow dung. Type how many kilograms of dung went into the bed.
voice.biomass: Biomass. Type how many kilograms of plant waste went into the bed.
voice.curing: Curing days. Type how many days the bed should rest.
voice.harvestBed: Harvest bed. Press this to record how much compost you collected.

hints.nameWhy: This is the name staff and customers will see for the nursery.
hints.codeWhy: The system creates a unique code when you save, so this nursery can be identified exactly.
hints.addressWhy: Where this place is. Type a few letters for suggestions, or use your current location.
hints.placeWhy: One nursery can have many places: a gate, a farm, or a branch. Add each one.
hints.phoneWhy: A phone number for this nursery, so people can be reached.
hints.onboardedWhy: The day this nursery is onboarded. The nursery list keeps this date.
hints.currencyWhy: Money shown as ৳ for Bangladesh or ₹ for India. Change this when the nursery is in India.
hints.adminWhy: The first person who will run this nursery and assign staff, cashier, and manager.
hints.emailWhy: Their own login. An email already used, including yours, cannot be reused.
hints.passwordWhy: The password they type to sign in. At least 6 characters.
hints.changePasswordWhy: A new sign-in password for this person. Leave it empty to keep the current one.
hints.featuresWhy: Tick only the work this nursery should use. Unticked pages stay hidden for everyone there.
hints.planWhy: Free is for a trial nursery. Silver, Golden, and Platinum are paid. You set the price and limits for the type you choose.
hints.priceWhy: What this nursery pays for the selected plan. You can change the number for this nursery.
hints.userLimitWhy: How many people can sign in at this nursery. Zero means no cap.
hints.plantLimitWhy: How many plant stock records this nursery can keep. Zero means no cap.
